messages:
Samir: Heads-up — customer on Dedicated reported an invoice mismatch after a mid-cycle downgrade. PO P-987654 attached. They say the partial refund / credit note is not showing in their portal for INV-2024-1129. Can accounting confirm if a credit was issued and whether VAT was split correctly?

Priya: Got it, forwarding to billing team. Do we have the invoice PDF and the downgrade timestamp?

Samir: Downgrade happened 2024-09-18 14:12 UTC. Invoice is attached in the ticket (link). Customer expects prorated credit for 12 days of the old plan.

Aria: Looking. I can see a credit note was generated (cn_9f3b) but status shows "failed_webhook". The amount on cn_9f3b is 1,200.00 which matches gross rather than net (VAT included) — customer portal subtracts VAT differently, so it doesn't reconcile.

Mateo: From logs: accounting webhook returned 422: {"error":"tax_line_mismatch","details":"expected tax lines for CN not present"}. Webhook payload we sent: 
```
{"credit_note_id":"cn_9f3b","invoice":"INV-2024-1129","lines":[{"amount":1200.00,"tax_percent":20}],"po":"P-987654"}
```
It looks like our payload included tax on the whole line, but the customer's ledger expects separate net and tax lines.

billing-bot: credit_note.created cn_9f3b status=failed_webhook reason=tax_line_mismatch at 2024-09-18T14:20:05Z

Aria: Proposed fix: regenerate credit note with explicit net + tax lines. Calculation used earlier was naive: 
```
prorated_credit = (remaining_days / billing_cycle_days) * plan_monthly_price
// previous: prorated_credit = (12/30)*1500 = 600 (gross) -> taxed to 720
// correct payload should send net=500, tax=100, total=600 (example numbers)
```
I'll run a dry-run with the accounting sandbox and attach PO.

Priya: If webhook succeeds we should see CN posted and portal will reflect it. Customer also reported portal balance still shows old invoice amount — maybe caching. Mateo can you force a portal cache refresh for that customer after we reissue?

Mateo: Yep — will hit /internal/portal/refresh?customer_id=acct_44F and watch for update. Also can retry the failed webhook using the stored payload (id: webhook_4489).

Aria: Running command now: `/finance reapply-credit --invoice INV-2024-1129 --po P-987654 --format net_tax --dry-run` — sandbox OK. Will run without --dry-run in 10m and post new CN id.

Samir: Thanks. Can we also attach a short note for CS to send to customer explaining VAT split and timing? They asked why the portal didn't show the number they expected.

Aria: Added note to ticket: "Reissued credit note with explicit net and VAT lines to match your accounting view. It may take ~10 minutes for portal cache to update. If you need an immediate PDF, reply and we'll attach it."

billing-bot: credit_note.created cn_9f3b_retry status=success id=cn_a12c at 2024-09-18T14:27:30Z

Samir: Awesome — closing the loop with the customer now. Thanks @Aria @Mateo :thumbsup:
